# The ESPHome release this repository builds with, as a pip requirement. The workflows (qa,
# esphome-release, nightly) install from this file and key their caches on its hash. The same
# number is written in firmware/scripts/dev.py and firmware/scripts/esphome-upstream-check.sh:
# version-lint.py holds the three equal, firmware/scripts/pin-bump.py moves them together (the
# pin-bumps workflow), and a pull request that bumps this line by hand fails CI until the other
# two are bumped with it, which is the reminder.
esphome==2026.10.1
